body: The kit is sealed and pushed behind a rat-chewed board. One bandage has been set on top, dry and neatly folded as if someone expected to return for it.
title: The first-aid kit under the kitchen shelf
gloss: A sealed kit and one unused dressing remain behind a damaged board.
rival_reading: A household could keep supplies behind a damaged shelf while treating pests; the bandage does not show an official response failure.

body: The empty sprayer is tacky around its trigger. A notebook page has dried against its side; the page shows a rat-chewed root beside three crop rows.
title: The spray bottle with a page stuck to it
gloss: A pest-control tool and a damaged root are recorded together.
rival_reading: Someone dealing with a household pest problem could use a garden sprayer and record damaged food; the sketch does not prove an experimental mixture.
